sentences.text: Naomi Grace Scott -LRB- born 6 May 1993 -RRB- is an English actress and singer .

She is known for starring as Kimberly Hart , the Pink Ranger , in the 2017 Power Rangers movie and co-starring as Maddy Shannon in the science-fiction drama series Terra Nova .	Kimberly Hart	Kimberly Hart	Power Rangers	Power Rangers (film)	Terra Nova	Terra Nova (TV series)

Scott also starred as Mohini `` Mo '' Banjaree in the Disney Channel original movie Lemonade Mouth , and as Megan in TV series Life Bites .	Disney Channel	Disney Channel	Lemonade Mouth	Lemonade Mouth (film)	Life Bites	Life Bites
